report.summary: Reviewed vendors.py chunk 9: OllamaBenchAdapter class, vendor availability dataclass and function.
risks: OllamaBenchAdapter.__init__ | medium | host.rstrip('/') may modify URL; if host is '/' it becomes empty string. | Check if host can be '/' and if empty string is acceptable.

OllamaBenchAdapter._dispatch | medium | Over-budget prompt returns 'over_context_budget' but does not raise exception; caller must handle error status. | Verify all callers check status field before using content.

available_vendors | low | agy_signed_in default is False, but comment says 'operator asserts sign-in'; no mechanism to assert from outside. | Ensure there is a way to set agy_signed_in to True when appropriate.
todos: Verify that lane_for_host('trusted') is correct for default host and that local attribute is used consistently.
Ensure that effective_input_window() and count_tokens() are defined and work as expected.
Check that VendorAvailability dataclass is used correctly in the registry.

handoff.purpose: Defines OllamaBenchAdapter class and VendorAvailability dataclass with available_vendors function.

symbols.name: OllamaBenchAdapter
symbols.note: Adapter for a bench Ollama host; overrides _dispatch with budget check and error handling.

symbols.name: OllamaBenchAdapter.__init__
symbols.note: Sets host, output_reserve, _chat, endpoint, and local attribute via lane_for_host.

symbols.name: OllamaBenchAdapter.independence_class
symbols.note: Returns tuple ('local', model_family(self.model)). Not keyed on host.

symbols.name: OllamaBenchAdapter._dispatch
symbols.note: Checks token budget, calls _chat, returns status dict with error handling.

symbols.name: VendorAvailability
symbols.note: Dataclass for cheap probe result; fields vendor, adapter, available, reason, detail, independence_class, endpoint, lane.

symbols.name: available_vendors
symbols.note: Returns tuple of VendorAvailability; uses injectable which and http_probe; no model invoked.

claims.text: loopback only, the same predicate that decides the egress lane, so the two cannot disagree about one host.
claims.why: Refers to egress lane predicate not defined in this chunk.
_dispatch returns error dict with 'over_context_budget' reason and stderr message.

claims.text: Ollama HEAD-truncates an over-long prompt -- it eats the system prompt first -- so a silently truncated council turn is a reviewer that never saw the question it is answering.
claims.why: Describes Ollama behavior not verified in this chunk.

claims.text: The budget is ``_ollama_native.effective_input_window()`` (full ``num_ctx`` minus the generation reserve), reused rather than reinvented.
claims.why: Refers to _ollama_native and effective_input_window not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: ONE predicate, shared with the egress gate it feeds. Not a local copy: ``local`` and ``lane`` must never be able to disagree about the same host, and they did (``[::1]`` was local-but-untrusted).
claims.why: Refers to egress gate and lane logic outside this chunk.

claims.text: Deliberately NOT keyed on host: local 7b and bench 7b are the same weights, so they must collide as one class.
Cheap probe result.  No model is invoked to produce this.
claims.why: Dataclass has no methods; used in available_vendors which does not invoke models.

claims.text: Which vendors could be seated, established by CHEAP PROBES ONLY.
claims.why: Function uses injectable which and http_probe; comment says no model invoked.

claims.text: Does the binary exist; does the Ollama host answer ``/api/version``.  No model is invoked, no prompt is sent, nothing is billed.
claims.why: http_probe defaults to server_reachable; actual probe behavior not shown in this chunk.

claims.text: ``agy`` is reported unavailable until an operator asserts sign-in: the only way to test its auth is to call it, and a probe that calls a model is not a probe.
claims.why: agy handling not shown in this chunk; only agy_signed_in parameter is present.

claims.text: Both callables are injectable so a test can establish availability with no CLI on PATH and no network.
claims.why: Function signature includes which and http_probe parameters with defaults.

observations.what: OllamaBenchAdapter.__init__ sets self.local based on lane_for_host(self.host) == 'trusted'. The comment explains this is to avoid disagreement with egress lane.
OllamaBenchAdapter._dispatch returns error dict with status 'over_context_budget' if token count exceeds window. It also handles ProviderHTTPError with specific checks for timeout and connectivity.
available_vendors returns a tuple of VendorAvailability. In this chunk, only ClaudeAdapter availability is computed (using which('claude')).
